The data set was divided into training (`r nrow(a2_train)` observations, 50%), validation (`r nrow(a2_valid)`, 25%) and test (`r nrow(a2_test)`, 25%) sets using the partitioning code from Lecture 1a, slide 34, with `set.seed(12345)`.
